name: @metorial/alpha-vantage
description: Retrieve stock prices, quotes, symbol search, company fundamentals, financial statements, earnings, dividends and splits, ETF profiles and holdings, insider transactions, earnings forecasts and transcripts, forex and cryptocurrency prices, commodities, economic series, technical indicators, market news, options chains, and global market status. Historical and realtime availability depends on the API plan. Quotes and top movers update at the end of the trading day by default; premium entitlements enable realtime or delayed US market data.
